title: updated_at on whiteboard rows is stamped at insert and moved by no whiteboard writer
body:
`updated_at` on whiteboard rows is stamped at insert and moved by no whiteboard writer. On devbin's store (Intent 3.0.3 `d24487079`): on `wb_node` it is behind `heartbeat_at` on all four rows -- devbin/dc's `wb pickup --focus` changed focus, session and heartbeat and left `updated_at` at registration time, and migrate and pickup never moved it on the other three; on `wb_item` all 40 archived items keep `updated_at` equal to `recorded_at`, none moved at or after `archived_at`. No triggers exist on the `wb_*` tables. The column claims "last changed" and nothing keeps it. Devbin letter O, found by devbin/vc on nodes and widened to items by devbin/dc.

Found by devbin migrating its boards on Intent 3.0.3 (`d24487079`), sent through intent/vc on hv's routing, and ruled by hv on 2026-09-16 to be fixed in this release (hv decision 18). The full measurement record, with the instrument (`carry-map.sh`, driven red and green) and who measured what, is devbin `1824c75`, `intent/whiteboard/dc/.history/20260916/wb-upstream-defects-draft.md`.

Note: per the `sync --to-store` issue filed with this one (devbin letter N), the one command observed moving `updated_at` on every whiteboard row is the sync that reports it changed nothing, while the verbs that do edit a row leave it alone. With the `event_log` issue (letter J), the store keeps no trace that a board row was edited after insert.

Fix: every whiteboard write that changes a row sets `updated_at` from the service's clock, or the column is removed.
